answer: Adaptive Inter-Arrival Window (AIW). Each agent identity must keep its request inter-arrival timing inside a rolling histogram the network fits to established agents, recalibrating like a mesa under seasonal rain. A new identity whose traffic shape stays more uniform than a glacier's melt curve is throttled to one probe per epoch until it matches. Attackers must run each fake agent through weeks of shaped, jittered traffic on a dedicated thread, multiplying infrastructure and time cost per identity.
